issues: Unsafe, self-contradictory beginner advice: 'Se nunca conduziu uma moto, uma scooter automática...' and 'Primeira vez numa moto, só cidade: scooter automática' steer unlicensed first-timers to A1-class scooters.
Honda Lead, Yamaha Exciter and 'modelos maiores para viagens longas' are attributed to Motogo/Vexere listings that do not contain them.
'Se a sua carta só habilita a conduzir automóveis, alugar uma moto acima do que a carta permite...' is illogical (every motorbike is above a car-only licence).
Unidiomatic 'a duas rodas certa' in first sentence and meta description.
Dangling reference 'veja os custos de aluguer' with no link (PT-H02 unpublished).
Missed: Portuguese MFA advice not to leave the passport as a deposit; Vexere shops limit use to the old Hanoi city area; Portal das Comunidades not linked in the body.
'Verificações antes de aceitar a moto' repeats the published /pt/checklist/ items.
About half of the body is sentence-parallel with NL-H01; rewrite natively.
Owner note: drafts use European Portuguese while live /pt/ uses Brazilian 'aluguel'.
notes: Sources opened live on 2026-10-15. Verified: Portal das Comunidades (updated 22/09/2026) on frequent road accidents and helmet use; Portugal (2010) and Brazil (1980) are parties to the 1968 convention; Law 36/2024 Art. 57 A1/A limits; IDP must be carried with a national licence of the matching class; low-emission-zone dates. Language is natural European Portuguese. Search intent and factual accuracy fail: beginner advice steers first-time riders to 110-125 cm3 scooters, contradicting the licence section, and model names are attributed to listings that do not contain them. Reviewer: a separate Claude subagent instance with fresh context and web access; same model family as the writer session, not a human.
